title: The FalseWork Papers
description: An open research programme on kernels, commas, and the structural limits of generative systems. Six CC-BY-4.0 papers with an open validation queue, plus a preprint series and a Lean 4 formalization with kernel-checked artifacts. This release adds the aperture programme: a preprint defining the aperture of a distinction (observer-relative ordinariness in Heyting algebras, with latently ordinary elements and a closed-form aperture count on divisor lattices, the central steps kernel-checked in Lean 4 against Mathlib4), and an empirical study applying the aperture instrument to Mathlib's import structure (seven pre-registered scripts: narrow-aperture cones vs degree-preserving nulls, latency in the wild, invariant deflation tests, and a three-year git-history consolidation analysis). The repository maintains authoritative Markdown sources, per-paper release archives, public validation items, Wolfram Language verification runs, and a correction architecture described in Paper 2.
